note: Curated, locally-matched CVE subset for the vulnerability scanner. match is a case-insensitive substring of the installed product name; version_lt means the product is vulnerable below that version. Extend freely.

cves.description: Log4Shell - unauthenticated remote code execution in Apache Log4j JNDI lookup.
cves.remediation: Upgrade Apache Log4j to 2.17.1+ (or 2.15.0+); if Log4j is embedded, update the parent application.

cves.description: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset - protocol-level denial of service affecting HTTP/2 servers.
cves.remediation: Apply vendor patches and rate-limit / cap concurrent HTTP/2 streams on load balancers and servers.

cves.description: PrintNightmare - Windows Print Spooler remote code execution.
cves.remediation: Install KB5005010+, disable the Print Spooler service where not required, restrict Point and Print.

cves.description: EternalBlue - SMBv1 remote code execution (WannaCry/NotPetya vector).
cves.remediation: Apply MS17-010 patch, disable SMBv1, segment SMB traffic.

cves.description: BlueKeep - RDP remote code execution on unpatched Windows.
cves.remediation: Apply the 2019-05 security update, enable NLA, block RDP at the perimeter.

cves.description: Heap buffer overflow in WebP image processing (browser/application exposure).
cves.remediation: Update libwebp and any browsers/applications embedding it to 1.3.2+.

cves.description: Backdoor (CVE-2024-3094) in XZ Utils 5.6.0/5.6.1 build tooling.
cves.remediation: Downgrade XZ Utils to 5.4.x or upgrade to a patched 5.6.1+ build.

cves.description: ProxyLogon - on-premises Exchange Server remote code execution chain.
cves.remediation: Apply the March 2021 Exchange Server cumulative update and run Microsoft's mitigation scripts.
